schema:name: Skilled Laborer Sealing Coffee Bag, Jardin, Colombia
schema:description: This image depicts a worker sealing a coffee bag with a handheld stitching machine. Hacienda La Minita, Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, maintains relationships with specialty coffee producers, millers, and exporters around the world. In Jardín, Colombia, Hacienda La Minita works directly with coffee producers through purchasing and quality programs and processes regional coffees through its milling operation in Jardín, where coffees are prepared for export.
